tv_script_name: Dual Bollinger Band Cross Strategy v6
indentation_source: direct DOM extraction (monaco-editor-tv-pine-dark content spans), grouped by bounding-box top coordinate into lines
notes: Author's doc: 'can be used on any time frame but for best output do not use below 30min timeframe' -- a floor, not a ceiling, so daily bars are compatible. Very simple mechanism: fast (5,1) vs slow (10,2) Bollinger midline cross for entry (fastMid > slowMid and close > fastMid), exit on close < slowMid. Long-only. 39 lines, 4 params.
